steps.instruction: On the currently open ticket detail view for '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}), attempt to change the ticket's status to 'Ready'. The app enforces preconditions before it will accept that status — if it refuses, read the exact error/validation message it shows and report it verbatim. Do NOT try to satisfy the preconditions yet; just attempt the change and report exactly what the app says (or, if it succeeds, report the new status).

Reload the ticket detail page for '{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket' ({{01-open.ticket_reference}}) fresh and report the exact Status value shown, the parts table contents, and any validation notes, warnings, or help text visible anywhere on the page about status transitions or requirements for the 'Ready' status. Also report whether any 'Mark Ready' button still exists.

IMPORTANT: do not modify ticket {{01-open.ticket_reference}} ('{{runid}} RD Bench Ticket') in any way - it must stay in Ready status with its two parts. Instead, create a NEW scratch ticket titled exactly '{{runid}} RD Scratch Probe' with a customer filled in but NO parts added. Then on that scratch ticket, attempt to change its status to Ready. If the app refuses, report the exact error/validation message verbatim. Then discover the minimum preconditions: satisfy them ONE change at a time (e.g. add a part, fill a required field), retrying the Ready status change after each single change, until the app accepts it. Report: (a) the exact error message(s) the app showed when it refused, and (b) exactly which change(s) were required before it accepted Ready. Leave the scratch ticket as-is afterwards.
